description: SessionStart injects the derived deficit → resolution table once per context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact), and the premise index beneath it with every path absolute — scripts/route-session.mjs. UserPromptSubmit carries the firing conditions for /route beside every prompt, for a deficit held in the request and for one the accumulated context shows alike, applied at the prompt and again at any recognition during the turn, and narrows /route to monitor mode while a gate holds the user's judgment — scripts/route-prompt.mjs. A second UserPromptSubmit entry, registered separately so its failure cannot suppress the first, may add an advisory line naming protocols the prompt looks like it fits; it stays silent and touches no network unless a key is present in the environment variable config/evaluator.json names, which is the whole of what arms it — scripts/route-evaluator.mjs. PreToolUse delivers a premise entry again at the tool call the matcher decides is its moment — scripts/route-tool.mjs. Only `description` and `hooks` go in this file: Codex rejects any other top-level key and then registers none of these hooks.
